known_issues: The preview cases read the reply through the mod's ShowBundle RPC handler with SendModRPCToClient replaced for the duration of the call; an implementation that sends the preview through a different RPC name would fail them. The exam names the ShowBundle request.
Preview drawing is checked through the fields of the server's reply that the mod's sbitemtile reads (`show_spoiled`, `spoil`, `perish`); no client widget is drawn.
